title: Titanium dioxide nanoparticle — nanoparticles
description: The titanium dioxide nanoparticle is a 0D nanomaterial with definition: 1–100 nm in at least one dimension; uv: absorbs ultraviolet light. Fabrication route: sol-gel process. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
